title: Training Long-Context, Multi-Turn Software Engineering Agents with Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Alexander Golubev、Maria Trofimova、Sergei Polezhaev、Ibragim Badertdinov、Maksim Nekrashevich、Anton Shevtsov、Simon Karasik、Sergey Abramov、Andrei Andriushchenko、Filipp Fisin、Sergei Skvortsov、Boris Yangel
paper_type_zh: 软件工程智能体强化学习与轨迹构造方法论文
best_for_zh: 研究环境交互轨迹、软件工程 agent、RFT/RLVR、终局验证器、长上下文训练与可重放性审计的读者
one_line: The paper filters 21,336 SWE-rebench tasks to 7,249, keeps 6,548 test-passing self-generated episodes for RFT, then applies synchronous DAPO to 65k/131k repository interactions, but does not release the trajectories, training code, or checkpoint.
论文从 21,336 个 SWE-rebench 任务筛出 7,249 个任务，以测试通过的 6,548 条自生成 episode 做 RFT，再以终局测试奖励训练长上下文 DAPO agent；其训练轨迹、代码与模型均未发布。
why: It specifies how repository state, tool observations, test-based terminal reward, success-only warm-up data, long-context rollout groups, and failure retention interact in SWE-agent post-training, while showing why upstream task containers alone do not make the paper's learning data reusable or replayable.
inclusion_reason: The paper gives a concrete, environment-grounded recipe for converting pinned repository tasks into successful RFT episodes and on-policy long-context RL trajectories with executable terminal rewards, while its missing trajectory, checkpoint, and replay release makes the audit boundary equally informative.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The audited source is arXiv:2508.03501v2, revised 10 October 2025, together with the official OpenReview forum. The venue record says only “Submitted to ICLR 2026”; no acceptance or proceedings publication has been verified. The paper asks how to train a 72B software-engineering agent over repository interactions that can last tens of turns and up to 131k context tokens, where feedback arrives mainly after a patch is submitted.

The relevant object for the atlas is not merely a task prompt or final patch. A training episode begins with a GitHub issue and a sandboxed repository snapshot, then records a sequence of model reasoning/command actions and environment observations (stdout, stderr, and exit codes), ending with a submitted repository state, validation outcome, length penalty, and scalar reward. The hidden state includes files, source code, and running processes. This makes the work a direct instance of environment_agent_trajectory_data: state, action, observation, environment feedback, terminal predicate, failure retention, and replay metadata determine what can be learned from the record.

The public substrate is SWE-rebench: 21,336 tasks from approximately 3,400 Python repositories, with issue text, repository/setup commits, gold and test patches, test lists, installation metadata, quality metadata, and per-repository license names. The paper applies correctness, complexity, LLM-quality, and 50-run determinism filters to obtain 7,249 training tasks, but does not publish the selected instance manifest or filter decisions. An upstream SWE-bench execution fork and a registry announced as containing 7,500 pre-built task containers are public; neither is the paper-specific trajectory corpus.

The decision boundary is therefore construction-recipe and training-report inclusion, not reusable-data-release inclusion. The authors describe 6,548 successful RFT trajectories and online RL rollout groups, yet the task manifests, RFT and RL trajectories, failed RFT attempts, rewards, submitted patches, checkpoint, internal JAX training code, and immutable replay bundle are unavailable. This Card reaches L4 content depth by auditing the paper, appendices, OpenReview status, pinned upstream dataset revisions, execution fork, and container announcement; it does not upgrade the accepted metadata beyond L3_summary_ready.

核验对象为 2025 年 10 月 10 日修订的 arXiv:2508.03501v2 以及官方 OpenReview 页面。会议记录仅写明“Submitted to ICLR 2026”；尚未核验到接收决定或正式论文集记录。论文研究的问题是：当软件工程 agent 需要进行数十轮仓库交互、上下文最长达到 131k token，而反馈主要在提交补丁后才出现时，如何训练一个 72B agent。

Atlas 所关心的对象不只是任务 prompt 或最终 patch。一条训练 episode 从 GitHub issue 和沙箱化仓库快照开始，随后包含模型推理/命令动作与环境 observation（stdout、stderr、exit code）的有序序列，最终形成提交后的仓库状态、验证结果、长度惩罚与标量奖励。隐藏状态包括文件、源代码和运行进程。因此该工作直接属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data：state、action、observation、环境反馈、terminal predicate、失败样本保留方式和 replay 元数据共同决定记录可支持怎样的学习。

公开底座是 SWE-rebench：21,336 个任务，来自约 3,400 个 Python 仓库；公开字段包括 issue 文本、仓库与环境设置 commit、gold patch、test patch、测试列表、安装元数据、质量元数据和逐仓库许可名称。论文通过正确性、复杂度、LLM 质量和 50 次重复测试确定性过滤得到 7,249 个训练任务，但没有发布所选 instance manifest 或逐条过滤决定。上游 SWE-bench 执行 fork 与一个宣布包含 7,500 个预构建任务 container 的 registry 已公开；两者都不是论文专属轨迹语料。

因此，本 Card 的收录边界是构造 recipe 与训练报告，而不是可复用数据发布。论文描述了 6,548 条成功 RFT trajectory 与在线 RL rollout group，但任务 manifest、RFT/RL trajectory、失败的 RFT 尝试、reward、提交 patch、checkpoint、内部 JAX 训练代码和不可变 replay bundle 均不可获得。本 Card 通过论文、附录、OpenReview 状态、固定版本的上游数据、执行 fork 和 container 公告完成 L4 内容审计，但不把 accepted metadata 的 L3_summary_ready 升级。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a two-step self-training recipe: first warm up Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on self-generated repository episodes that pass executable tests, then continue with synchronous on-policy DAPO over groups of 10 long, multi-turn episodes whose terminal rewards are computed in isolated software environments.

Each episode couples an issue-conditioned repository state with a complete action-observation history. Available actions include arbitrary shell commands, line-range editing, search/navigation utilities, file creation, and a no-argument submit. The verifier observes the final environment and validation suite, not the correctness of each reasoning step. Before length shaping, a submitted patch receives 1 only if all required validation tests pass and 0 otherwise. A step penalty is zero for the first 10 turns and then decreases linearly toward -1 at the turn cap. Within each 10-rollout task group, final rewards are normalized; one trajectory-level advantage is broadcast to all tokens, and zero-advantage samples are dropped.

The feedback contract is consequently executable but sparse. It can test the final repository under the retained suite and penalize long episodes, but it cannot attribute credit to individual commands, certify semantic correctness beyond the tests, detect unsafe intermediate behavior, or teach calibrated abstention. RFT further changes the observed distribution by keeping only terminal successes, although malformed assistant turns inside a kept episode are masked. RL can use both successes and failures when the group has reward variation; homogeneous zero-advantage groups do not update the model.

Relative to the public SWE-rebench substrate, the paper adds paper-specific filtering, successful-episode RFT, two long-context RL stages, and a precise terminal reward/training interface. Relative to broad agentic RL recipes such as Agent-RLVR, its distinctive evidence surface is repository repair with full shell/edit observations, 65k/131k context, and executable validation. It does not introduce the underlying SWE-rebench tasks, shell-agent paradigm, binary test oracle, or DAPO objective, and it does not release a new trajectory dataset.

论文的贡献是一套两步自训练 recipe：先让 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 自行生成仓库交互 episode，只用通过可执行测试的样本进行 warm-up；再对每个任务采样 10 条长程、多轮 episode，在隔离软件环境中计算终局 reward，并进行同步 on-policy DAPO。

每条 episode 把 issue 条件化的仓库状态与完整 action-observation history 绑定在一起。可用动作包括任意 shell command、按行区间编辑、搜索/导航工具、文件创建和无参数 submit。verifier 观察最终环境与 validation suite，而不判断每一步推理是否正确。长度 shaping 之前，提交 patch 只有在通过全部所需验证测试时才得 1，否则得 0。step penalty 在前 10 轮为 0，之后随轮数线性下降，到 turn cap 时接近 -1。每个任务的 10 条 rollout 组内会对最终 reward 做归一化；同一个 trajectory-level advantage 广播到该轨迹全部 token，零 advantage 样本被丢弃。

因此，这个 feedback contract 可执行但稀疏。它可以用保留测试集检查最终仓库并惩罚过长 episode，却不能给单条命令做 credit assignment，不能证明超出测试覆盖范围的语义正确性，不能发现不安全的中间行为，也不能训练校准后的 abstention。RFT 只保留终局成功样本，进一步改变了可见分布；保留 episode 内触发格式错误的 assistant turn 则会被 mask。RL 在组内 reward 有差异时可同时利用成功和失败轨迹；全组 advantage 为零时不会产生更新。

相较公开的 SWE-rebench 底座，论文增加了论文专属过滤、成功 episode RFT、两阶段长上下文 RL，以及明确的终局 reward/训练接口。相较 Agent-RLVR 等一般性 agentic RL recipe，它的特定证据面是具有完整 shell/edit observation、65k/131k context 与可执行验证的软件仓库修复。论文没有发明 SWE-rebench 任务、shell-agent 范式、二元测试 oracle 或 DAPO objective，也没有发布新的 trajectory dataset。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are SWE-rebench repository-repair tasks. The upstream pool has 21,336 rows. The paper removes cases with metadata indicating invalid references or import failures, keeps tasks changing at most 7 files and fewer than 500 lines, excludes problems assigned an LLM quality score of 3.0, and rejects tests that vary over 50 repeated executions. The resulting 7,249-task manifest is not released. May and June SWE-rebench monthly splits are excluded from training; a random Verified-50 subset is used for intermediate checkpoint evaluation.

For rejection fine-tuning, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct runs 10 attempts on selected tasks. A successful one-shot trajectory is appended only while collecting these base-checkpoint attempts; its provenance is unknown and it is removed for later RFT and RL agents. The pipeline retains 6,548 complete test-passing episodes, masks assistant turns that caused environment-formatting errors, and performs 1 SFT epoch. Reported RFT settings are 65k context, AdamW at 5e-6, weight decay 0.1, batch size 64, 10 warmup steps, cosine decay to 0, and 50 updates.

RL is synchronous and on-policy. In each iteration, the current policy samples 10 complete trajectories per problem at temperature 1.0 with top_p, top_k, min_p, repetition penalty, and other decoding filters disabled. The environment executes commands and tests the submitted patch. Final reward is binary test success plus the turn-length penalty; rewards are normalized within the 10-trajectory group, broadcast to tokens, and optimized with DAPO's clipped token-level objective. All parameters are updated with AdamW at 1e-6, 1 epoch per iteration, and gradient clipping 1.0.

Stage 1 uses 300 problems per iteration, batch size 128, a 65k-token context, and at most 40 turns. Stage 2 uses 100 problems per iteration, batch size 256, a 131k-token context enabled by YaRN factor 4.0, and at most 80 turns. Stage 2 uses 2,028 problems after removing tasks reported as having a 2/3 training success rate and tasks never solved; the exact inequality, measurement window, and manifest are unknown. Total online rollout count, random seeds, and retention after synchronous use are not disclosed.

Training ran on 16 H200 nodes with 8 GPUs each, context parallelism, Kubernetes pods for agents, Tracto AI evaluation, an internal JAX trainer, and vLLM 0.7.4 inference. Reproduction requires the exact 7,249/2,028 manifests, container digests and task mapping, repository/test snapshots, dependencies, scaffold revision, prompts, decoding configuration, seeds, reset/timeout/network semantics, rollout records, checkpoints, and internal trainer. Only the upstream task rows, runner fork, container registry, paper prompt/tool appendix, and reported settings are public.

输入是 SWE-rebench 仓库修复任务，上游共有 21,336 条记录。论文删除元数据提示无效引用或 import failure 的样本，只保留最多修改 7 个文件且修改行数少于 500 的任务，排除 LLM 质量分数为 3.0 的问题，并通过 50 次重复执行剔除测试结果不一致的任务。最终 7,249 个任务的 manifest 未发布。SWE-rebench 的 May/June 月度 split 被排除在训练外；随机抽取的 Verified-50 用于中间 checkpoint 评估。

在 rejection fine-tuning 阶段，Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 对所选任务各运行 10 次。仅收集 base-checkpoint 尝试时，prompt 会附加一条成功的 one-shot trajectory；其来源未知，后续 RFT 与 RL agent 均不再使用。pipeline 保留 6,548 条完整且通过测试的 episode，对引发环境格式错误的 assistant turn 做 mask，然后进行 1 个 epoch 的 SFT。公开的 RFT 设置为 65k context、AdamW 5e-6、weight decay 0.1、batch size 64、10 个 warmup step、cosine decay 到 0，共 50 次 update。

RL 采用同步 on-policy 流程。每次 iteration 中，当前 policy 对每个问题以 temperature 1.0 采样 10 条完整 trajectory；top_p、top_k、min_p、repetition penalty 和其他 decoding filter 均关闭。环境执行命令并测试提交 patch。最终 reward 是二元测试成功值加轮数长度惩罚；reward 在 10 条 trajectory 的组内归一化，再广播到 token，并用 DAPO 的 clipped token-level objective 优化。全部参数以 AdamW 1e-6、每 iteration 1 个 epoch、gradient clipping 1.0 更新。

Stage 1 每 iteration 使用 300 个问题，batch size 128，context 65k，最多 40 轮。Stage 2 每 iteration 使用 100 个问题，batch size 256，通过 YaRN factor 4.0 将 context 扩展到 131k，最多 80 轮。Stage 2 保留 2,028 个问题，论文称移除了训练成功率为 2/3 的任务和从未解决的任务；精确不等式、统计窗口和 manifest 未披露。在线 rollout 总数、随机种子以及同步使用后的保存策略均未知。

训练使用 16 个 H200 节点，每节点 8 张 GPU，并使用 context parallelism、agent Kubernetes pod、Tracto AI evaluation、内部 JAX trainer 和 vLLM 0.7.4 inference。复现需要精确的 7,249/2,028 manifest、container digest 与任务映射、仓库/测试快照、依赖、scaffold revision、prompt、decoding 配置、seed、reset/timeout/network 语义、rollout 记录、checkpoint 和内部 trainer。目前公开的只有上游任务行、runner fork、container registry、论文 prompt/tool 附录与报告的设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main evidence is an author-reported training progression on SWE-bench Verified. Pass@1 is 11.4% for the base Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct agent, 20.5% after RFT, 35.7% after Stage 1 RL, and 39.0% after Stage 2 RL. The final checkpoint reaches 35.0% on the held-out May SWE-rebench split and 31.7% on June. These numbers are tied to the paper's scaffold, validation harness, long-context budgets, and checkpoint-selection process; no released model or independent reproduction was verified (Table 1).

The staged comparison supports the narrower claim that terminally verified self-generated RFT followed by on-policy RL correlates with higher repair pass rates under the reported setup. It does not isolate every change: Stage 2 simultaneously changes task selection, context length, turn limit, problems per iteration, and batch size. The score increase therefore does not prove that longer context alone, the 2,028-task curriculum alone, or the underlying trajectory corpus is higher quality.

A concrete negative result exposes sampling sensitivity. During training, a vLLM change began honoring model-config top_k and min_p, truncating the intended rollout distribution; performance degraded after 5–10 iterations. Restoring unfiltered sampling recovered performance. This is evidence that seemingly minor inference-version or configuration drift can alter the on-policy data distribution and training outcome, not merely an implementation footnote.

The paper also reports that deleting all over-context repetitive episodes removes useful negative examples. Its final design instead applies a soft length penalty, allowing both successful and failed RL trajectories to contribute when their ten-rollout group has reward variation. This contrasts with RFT, where failed attempts are rejected. The paper does not publish counts by RL outcome, trajectory lengths, zero-advantage drop rates, verifier false positives/negatives, or raw logs needed to audit those explanations.

All results remain author claims. Repeated use of Verified-50 across more than 100 RL iterations may influence checkpoint and design selection, while May/June exclusion is only a temporal training boundary. Neither benchmark scores nor passing tests establish dataset legality, lack of contamination, semantic patch quality beyond the tests, safe agent behavior, or replayability.

主要证据是作者在 SWE-bench Verified 上报告的训练阶段结果：base Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct agent 的 Pass@1 为 11.4%，RFT 后为 20.5%，Stage 1 RL 后为 35.7%，Stage 2 RL 后为 39.0%。最终 checkpoint 在保留的 May/June SWE-rebench split 上分别达到 35.0% 和 31.7%。这些数值依赖论文的 scaffold、validation harness、长上下文预算和 checkpoint 选择过程；尚未核验到发布模型或独立复现（Table 1）。

阶段对比支持一个较窄结论：在报告设置下，终局可验证的自生成 RFT 再接 on-policy RL，与更高的软件修复通过率相关。它不能隔离所有变量：Stage 2 同时改变任务选择、context length、turn limit、每 iteration 问题数和 batch size。因此，分数上升不能单独证明更长 context、2,028 任务 curriculum 或底层 trajectory corpus 本身质量更高。

论文给出了一项具体负面结果，显示 sampling 的敏感性。训练中途一次 vLLM 变更开始读取 model config 中的 top_k 与 min_p，使原本预期的 rollout 分布被截断；5–10 次 iteration 后性能下降。恢复无过滤 sampling 后性能回升。这说明 inference 版本或配置的细小漂移会改变 on-policy 数据分布与训练结果，而非无关紧要的工程细节。

论文还报告，直接删除所有超出 context 的重复循环 episode 会丢掉有用负样本。最终方案改用软长度惩罚，使同一 10-rollout group 内存在 reward 差异时，成功和失败 RL trajectory 都能贡献。RFT 则拒绝失败尝试。论文没有公布 RL 成败数量、轨迹长度分布、零 advantage 丢弃率、verifier false positive/false negative 或用于核验这些解释的原始日志。

所有结果仍是作者报告。超过 100 次 RL iteration 中反复使用 Verified-50 可能影响 checkpoint 与设计选择，而排除 May/June 只构成时间上的训练边界。benchmark 分数和测试通过都不能证明数据权利完备、无污染、patch 在测试覆盖外语义正确、agent 行为安全或 episode 可重放。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline has three separable layers: SWE-rebench supplies real repository tasks and executable environments; SWE-agent-style systems supply the shell/edit/search interaction loop; DAPO supplies the clipped token-level group-relative optimization objective. Binary test validation and success filtering are also established ideas. The paper's contribution is not any one of those components in isolation.

What changes is their coupling at long horizon and training scale. The authors specify a paper-specific 21,336-to-7,249 task filter, create 6,548 self-generated successful episodes for 1-epoch RFT without a stronger teacher, then train on synchronous groups of 10 repository episodes in two stages that expand from 65k/40 turns to 131k/80 turns. The same terminal interface connects repository execution, binary validation, a soft length penalty, group normalization, and token updates.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the contrast between outcome-conditioned warm-up data and mixed-outcome on-policy data. RFT erases whole failed attempts but retains successful episodes with selected malformed turns masked; RL can learn from relative differences among both successes and failures, while homogeneous groups are dropped. This makes sample retention and environment version part of the learning-data definition, rather than incidental preprocessing.

The quality signal is operational, not semantic: a trajectory is useful to the recipe when it leads to executable test success or has informative relative reward within its group. The verifier cannot establish correctness beyond the test suite, and the reported benchmark gains are not evidence that every retained trajectory is high quality. The closest reusable object remains upstream SWE-rebench; the paper-specific manifests and trajectories are not available.

Before reuse, a curator must verify the exact task IDs and filter implementation, the 2,028-task Stage 2 rule, group outcome statistics, test-oracle reliability, container/runtime pins, reset and replay semantics, trajectory rights, and contamination controls. Without those, the work is a precise method and audit reference, not a released training corpus.

已有工作的基线可拆成三层：SWE-rebench 提供真实仓库任务和可执行环境；SWE-agent 风格系统提供 shell/edit/search 交互循环；DAPO 提供 clipped token-level group-relative 优化目标。二元测试验证与成功样本过滤也不是新概念。论文贡献不在于孤立发明其中任一组件。

真正改变的是这些组件在长时程和训练规模上的耦合方式。作者给出论文专属的 21,336 到 7,249 任务过滤，使用 6,548 条自生成成功 episode、在没有更强 teacher 的情况下做 1 个 epoch RFT，随后以每组 10 条仓库 episode 的同步流程进行两阶段训练，并从 65k/40 轮扩展到 131k/80 轮。同一终局接口把仓库执行、二元验证、软长度惩罚、组内归一化和 token 更新连接起来。

对 reasoning data 研究而言，方向信号来自 outcome-conditioned warm-up 数据与混合 outcome 的 on-policy 数据之间的对比。RFT 删除整条失败尝试，但在成功 episode 内对部分格式错误 turn 做 mask；RL 可以利用成功与失败样本的相对差异，而同质 group 会被丢弃。因此，样本保留规则和环境版本属于学习数据定义本身，而不是偶然的预处理细节。

这里的质量信号是操作性的，而非语义性的：trajectory 对该 recipe 有用，是因为它产生可执行测试成功，或在组内具有信息性的相对 reward。verifier 不能证明超出 test suite 的正确性，benchmark 提升也不是每条保留 trajectory 都高质量的证据。最接近的可复用对象仍是上游 SWE-rebench；论文专属 manifest 与 trajectory 不可获得。

复用前必须核验精确任务 ID 与过滤实现、2,028 个 Stage 2 任务的规则、各 group 的 outcome 统计、测试 oracle 可靠性、container/runtime 固定版本、reset 与 replay 语义、trajectory 权利和污染控制。缺少这些信息时，该工作是具体的方法与审计参考，而不是已发布训练语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Methodologically, terminal binary reward is extremely sparse for episodes spanning thousands of tokens. Broadcasting one scalar advantage to every token cannot identify which command, observation interpretation, or edit caused success or failure. The authors also note that binary success encourages submitting a patch “at any cost” rather than abstaining under uncertainty. Incomplete tests can admit behaviorally wrong patches, while brittle tests can reject valid alternatives; no retained-suite false-positive or false-negative audit is reported.

Selection changes the observed behavior distribution. RFT keeps only 6,548 passing episodes and discards failed attempts, so its warm-up data overrepresent tasks already solvable by the base agent. RL preserves successes and failures only when group-relative rewards vary; zero-advantage groups contribute no update. The frequency, composition, and post-training persistence of online rollouts are unknown. The exact score-3.0 metadata field and Stage 2 selection inequality/window are also unspecified.

The release is insufficient for episode replay. Public rows include repo, base_commit, environment_setup_commit, test patches, F2P/P2P lists, and installation metadata, and 7,500 containers were announced. However, there is no exact 7,249/2,028 task-to-image manifest, immutable OCI digest set, dependency lock, random seed list, action/observation log, submitted patch record, reward log, checkpoint, or training configuration bundle. Reset semantics between 10 rollouts—including persistence of files or processes, timeout cleanup, and network state—are unknown.

Version drift is demonstrated rather than hypothetical. The paper pins vLLM 0.7.4, and an inference-setting change already caused training degradation. The public execution fork is pinned in this audit to commit 980d0cca8aa4e73f1d9f894e906370bef8c4de8a, while the dataset later gained a 6,542-row filtered split. That later object must not be confused with the paper's 6,548 RFT trajectories or 7,249-task training pool.

Contamination control is narrow. May/June are held out from training, but no broad repository deduplication, SWE-bench overlap audit, model-pretraining exposure analysis, or correction for repeated Verified-50 monitoring is reported. Consequently, the scores do not establish unseen-task generalization under a clean benchmark boundary.

Rights, privacy, and security remain unresolved. The manuscript and SWE-rebench card declare CC BY 4.0, the execution fork is MIT, and the dataset card requires respecting each source repository's license. Those statements do not reconcile rights in issues, comments, tests, dependencies, generated traces, model outputs, or checkpoints. No PII/consent/takedown process is described. The agent may run arbitrary shell commands and install packages in Kubernetes pods, but network isolation, credentials, syscall/capability restrictions, malicious-repository handling, and supply-chain controls are undisclosed.

从方法上看，对跨越数千 token 的 episode 使用终局二元 reward 极其稀疏。把一个 scalar advantage 广播给全部 token，无法定位究竟是哪条命令、哪次 observation 解释或哪项编辑造成成功/失败。作者还指出，binary success 会鼓励 agent “不惜代价”提交 patch，而不是在不确定时 abstain。不完整测试可能接受行为错误的 patch，脆弱测试也可能拒绝有效替代方案；论文没有报告保留测试集的 false-positive/false-negative 审计。

选择过程改变了可见行为分布。RFT 只保留 6,548 条通过测试的 episode 并丢弃失败尝试，因此 warm-up 数据会过度代表 base agent 已能解决的任务。RL 只有在 group-relative reward 有差异时才保留成功与失败的学习信号；零 advantage group 不产生更新。在线 rollout 的频率、构成以及训练后是否持久保存均未知。score 3.0 对应的精确元数据字段，以及 Stage 2 选择的不等式/统计窗口也未说明。

公开材料不足以 replay episode。任务行包含 repo、base_commit、environment_setup_commit、test patch、F2P/P2P 列表和安装元数据，且官方宣布了 7,500 个 container；但没有精确的 7,249/2,028 任务到镜像 manifest、不可变 OCI digest 集、依赖 lock、随机种子、action/observation log、提交 patch 记录、reward log、checkpoint 或训练配置 bundle。每个任务 10 条 rollout 之间的 reset 语义——包括文件/进程是否残留、timeout cleanup 和 network state——均未知。

版本漂移并非假设，而是已有证据。论文固定 vLLM 0.7.4，一次 inference 设置变更已经导致训练退化。本审计将公开执行 fork 固定在 commit 980d0cca8aa4e73f1d9f894e906370bef8c4de8a，而数据集后来增加了 6,542 行的 filtered split。这个后续对象不能与论文的 6,548 条 RFT trajectory 或 7,249 任务训练池混为一谈。

污染控制范围较窄。May/June 被排除在训练外，但论文未报告全面的仓库去重、SWE-bench overlap audit、模型预训练暴露分析，也未校正反复监控 Verified-50 的影响。因此，这些分数不能证明在干净 benchmark 边界下对未见任务的泛化。

权利、隐私与安全边界仍未解决。论文与 SWE-rebench card 声明 CC BY 4.0，执行 fork 使用 MIT，数据 card 要求同时遵守每个源仓库许可；这些声明没有统一解决 issue、comment、test、dependency、生成 trajectory、模型输出或 checkpoint 的权利。论文没有说明 PII/consent/takedown 流程。agent 可在 Kubernetes pod 内执行任意 shell command 并安装 package，但 network isolation、credential、syscall/capability 限制、恶意仓库处理和 supply-chain control 均未披露。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment-agent-trajectory track, the paper is most useful as a schema and training-contract reference. A comparable record should bind task identity and repository commits to the initial issue, ordered reasoning/actions, stdout/stderr/exit-code observations, submitted patch, terminal test result, length statistic, final reward, group membership, policy/checkpoint version, and environment image digest. Recording reset and abnormal-termination events would close gaps left by this paper.

The RFT/RL contrast is a concrete ablation template for data-selection research. One can compare success-only full episodes, success plus masked malformed turns, mixed-success on-policy groups, and retained hard failures while holding tasks, environment, and inference runtime fixed. Outcome counts and zero-advantage exclusions must be reported; otherwise performance differences cannot be attributed to the retention policy.

The verifier design is a useful baseline for RLVR and agent training: executable tests supply a terminal signal and a soft turn penalty discourages loops without deleting every long failure. A stronger replication should add held-out tests, mutation or adversarial test checks, per-step diagnostics, patch-scope constraints, unsafe-action logging, and abstention evaluation. These additions address test incompleteness and sparse credit without pretending the original paper implemented them.

The release also provides an audit checklist for infrastructure-sensitive on-policy data: pin sampler versions and all decoding flags, task and container manifests, repository/test commits, dependency locks, seeds, network policy, reset semantics, and rollout/checkpoint lineage. The reported vLLM incident makes this checklist empirically motivated.

Reuse class: the public SWE-rebench tasks, runner fork, and containers may support environment reconstruction subject to their own licenses and version checks. The paper-specific 7,249/2,028 selections, 6,548 RFT episodes, RL rollouts, rewards, model, and trainer are blocked pending release. Accordingly, this Card is safe as a reading, recipe, evaluation-design, and audit reference; it is not a downloadable training dataset or independently reproduced baseline.

对 environment-agent-trajectory track 而言，这篇论文最适合作为 schema 与训练契约参考。一个可对照的数据记录应把 task identity 与仓库 commit、初始 issue、有序 reasoning/action、stdout/stderr/exit-code observation、提交 patch、终局测试结果、长度统计、最终 reward、group membership、policy/checkpoint 版本和 environment image digest 绑定起来；同时记录 reset 与异常终止事件，才能补上论文留下的缺口。

RFT/RL 对比可直接形成数据选择研究的 ablation 模板：在固定任务、环境和 inference runtime 的条件下，比较成功 full episode、成功 episode 加格式错误 turn mask、成败混合的 on-policy group，以及保留 hard failure 的方案。必须报告 outcome 数量与零 advantage 排除情况，否则无法把性能差异归因到样本保留策略。

verifier 设计可作为 RLVR 与 agent training 的 baseline：可执行测试提供 terminal signal，软 turn penalty 抑制循环，却不删除所有长失败。更强的复现可以增加 held-out test、mutation/adversarial test 检查、逐步诊断、patch scope 约束、不安全 action 日志和 abstention 评估。这些是针对测试不完备和稀疏 credit 的后续设计，不代表原论文已经实现。

该工作也提供一份面向基础设施敏感 on-policy 数据的审计清单：固定 sampler 版本和全部 decoding flag、task/container manifest、仓库/test commit、dependency lock、seed、network policy、reset 语义以及 rollout/checkpoint lineage。论文报告的 vLLM 事故使这份清单具有直接实证依据。

复用等级方面，公开 SWE-rebench 任务、runner fork 和 container 可在各自许可与版本核验后支持环境重建；论文专属 7,249/2,028 选择、6,548 条 RFT episode、RL rollout、reward、model 与 trainer 均因未发布而阻塞。因此，本 Card 可安全用于阅读、recipe、评估设计和审计参考，但不是可下载训练数据或已独立复现的 baseline。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1–3.3 first for the POMDP, action grammar, terminal predicate, reward normalization, and the distinction between environment feedback and token supervision.
  • Pair Section 4 with Appendices C, D, and F: the main text gives the 7,249/6,548 construction flow, while the appendices supply hyperparameters, infrastructure, prompt, tools, and the RFT-only one-shot example.
  • Do not conflate three counts: 7,249 selected training tasks, 6,548 successful RFT trajectories, and the later upstream 6,542-row filtered split are different objects.
  • Read Section 5.2 as a data-versioning result: both deleting looping failures and silently enabling top_k/min_p changed the learning signal.
  • Verify next the exact task/image manifests, reset/network semantics, selected trajectories and rewards, checkpoint/trainer release, broad contamination, and rights/privacy/security controls.

• 先读 Sections 3.1–3.3，重点看 POMDP、action grammar、terminal predicate、reward normalization，以及环境反馈与 token supervision 的区别。
  • 将 Section 4 与 Appendices C、D、F 对照阅读：正文给出 7,249/6,548 的构造流程，附录补充 hyperparameter、基础设施、prompt、tool 和仅用于 RFT 收集的 one-shot example。
  • 不要混淆三个数字：7,249 个所选训练任务、6,548 条成功 RFT trajectory，以及上游后来出现的 6,542 行 filtered split 是不同对象。
  • 将 Section 5.2 视为数据版本问题来读：删除循环失败样本与静默启用 top_k/min_p 都改变了学习信号。
  • 后续优先核验精确 task/image manifest、reset/network 语义、所选 trajectory 与 reward、checkpoint/trainer 发布、全面污染检查，以及权利/隐私/安全控制。

value.html: During training, one record is a complete repository-repair episode: an issue-conditioned initial observation, a repository environment, an ordered action-observation history, a submitted patch, validation-test outcome, and episode reward. These paper-specific records are described but not released; the public SWE-rebench artifact contains task/environment rows instead.
GitHub issue descriptions from SWE-rebench. The public upstream pool has 21,336 tasks from about 3,400 Python repositories; the paper filters it to an unreleased 7,249-task training pool.

The hidden state is the complete sandboxed software environment, including repository files, source code, and running processes. The policy conditions on the full observable history of issue text, prior actions, stdout, stderr, and exit codes.
Initial GitHub issue text followed by command execution output, normally stdout, stderr, and exit codes, after each environment action.
A complete multi-turn command/observation episode ending in a repository patch submitted for executable validation.
The final modified repository state and submitted patch. Upstream task rows separately contain the historical gold patch; it is not an agent trajectory.
Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct generates the initial RFT attempts; the RFT policy and its successive DAPO policies generate later on-policy rollouts. No stronger teacher model generates the trajectories.

ReAct-style turns containing reasoning plus one command action: arbitrary shell, line-range edit, search/navigation, file creation, or submit. The paper publishes the prompt and tool grammar but not the collected histories.

A sandboxed Python repository snapshot with issue text, validation tests, shell/edit/search tools, and submit. Official upstream rows expose repository commits and installation/test metadata, and 7,500 pre-built task images were announced, but the paper's exact 7,249-task/image manifest is unavailable.

R_final equals binary validation-test success plus a step-count penalty. The penalty is zero before 10 turns and decreases linearly to -1 at the maximum turn budget; the trajectory reward is normalized within a 10-rollout group and broadcast to all trajectory tokens.

The submit command ends the episode. Before the length penalty, success is 1 only when the final proposed patch passes the validation suite and 0 otherwise. The 40- or 80-turn cap can truncate a rollout; other abnormal termination semantics are not disclosed.

Public artifacts are task/environment rows, an execution fork, and a container registry. The paper-specific RFT/RL trajectories, per-trajectory rewards, selected-task manifest, trained checkpoint, and replay bundle are unavailable.

Public SWE-rebench task/environment row -> paper-specific task filters -> 10 base-model attempts per selected task -> retain 6,548 test-passing episodes for one-epoch RFT while masking malformed assistant turns -> synchronous on-policy groups of 10 full trajectories -> test reward plus length penalty -> group-normalized DAPO update.
Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct
No external teacher model. A single successful in-context trajectory is used only while collecting the initial RFT rollouts; its provenance is unknown.
The base Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct checkpoint generates RFT candidates. The current RFT/DAPO policy then generates synchronous on-policy RL trajectories.

SWE-rebench GitHub issue tasks with repository snapshots and validation tests; Appendix F publishes the system-level instruction, tool descriptions, and the RFT-collection-only one-shot demonstration.

RFT runs the initial policy 10 times on each selected task and keeps 6,548 successful trajectories. Each RL iteration samples 10 complete trajectories for each chosen problem using the current policy; rewards are normalized per problem and the pipeline trains only after the whole synchronous batch is verified.

SWE-agent-like ReAct loop with shell commands, line-range editing, search/navigation, and submit; all prior actions and observations remain in context. Exact scaffold code and revision are not released.

{'maximum_modified_files': 7, 'maximum_modified_lines_exclusive': 500, 'excluded_llm_score': 3.0, 'flakiness_trials': 50, 'rft_terminal_success_required': True, 'stage_2_problem_policy': 'Remove tasks reported with a 2/3 success rate over training and tasks never solved; exact inequality, measurement window, and manifest are unknown.'}

From 21,336 tasks, remove invalid-reference/import failures, modifications above seven files or at least 500 lines, tasks with an assigned LLM quality score of 3.0, and tests that vary over 50 repeated executions, leaving 7,249. RFT keeps only test-passing episodes and masks formatting-error assistant turns. RL drops zero-advantage samples rather than categorically dropping all failures or long loops.
Stage 1 uses 65k context and at most 40 turns. Stage 2 uses 131k context and at most 80 turns, with a length-penalty threshold of 10 turns in both stages.

One RFT epoch at 65k context uses AdamW, learning rate 5e-6, weight decay 0.1, batch size 64, 10 warmup steps, cosine decay to zero, and 50 updates. RL uses synchronous full-parameter DAPO with AdamW, learning rate 1e-6, one epoch per iteration, gradient clipping 1.0, context parallelism, and YaRN factor 4.0. Stage 1/2 use 300/100 problems per iteration and batch sizes 128/256.
top_p, top_k, min_p, repetition_penalty, and other decoding filters are disabled for rollout generation; seeds are unknown.
16 H200 nodes with eight GPUs each; Kubernetes assigns one pod per agent; Tracto AI orchestrates evaluation; an internal JAX framework trains the model; vLLM 0.7.4 performs inference.

Real public GitHub issue/PR-derived Python repair tasks from SWE-rebench, self-generated successful RFT episodes, and on-policy successful and failed RL episodes. Only the upstream task/environment rows are publicly released.

Training uses an unreleased 7,249-task subset and then a 2,028-task Stage 2 subset. SWE-rebench May and June are explicitly excluded from training. Verified-50 is a disclosed random subset used repeatedly for intermediate evaluation; exact train/evaluation deduplication manifests are unavailable.

The paper does not report training on SWE-bench Verified, but a 50-instance subset is monitored across more than 100 RL iterations, so checkpoint and design selection may adapt to it. The full Verified set is public and no pretraining-exposure audit is provided.
May/June temporal holdout is reported, but no broad source deduplication, model-pretraining contamination screen, or complete SWE-bench overlap audit is disclosed.

RFT retains only 6,548 test-passing full episodes and masks malformed assistant turns inside those episodes; failed RFT attempts are discarded and unreleased. RL can retain both success and failure when a 10-rollout group has nonzero relative advantages, while all zero-advantage samples are dropped and long episodes receive a soft penalty. Whether any online rollout is persisted after synchronous training is unknown; none is publicly released.

Upstream tasks expose repository/setup/test metadata and some task containers, but exact image digests, 7,249/2,028 manifests, dependency snapshots, reset semantics, seeds, action/observation logs, submitted patches, reward records, policies, and the internal trainer are missing. Paper episodes are not deterministically replayable from public artifacts.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Validation tests can be incomplete or accidentally encode identifiers not inferable from the issue; the paper removes some invalid cases but publishes no false-positive/false-negative audit of the retained oracle.
Test flakiness creates reward noise; 50-trial filtering reduces but does not prove deterministic behavior under dependency, service, or hardware drift.
One terminal scalar broadcast over a long episode provides weak credit assignment and can reward a passing patch despite poor intermediate behavior.
Binary success encourages patch submission at any cost and does not train calibrated abstention or uncertainty.
Group-relative sampling drops homogeneous zero-advantage groups, so very easy and uniformly failed tasks contribute no update under that batch.
Discarding overlong looping trajectories hides negative examples; the paper identifies this failure and instead specifies a soft step penalty.
A vLLM upgrade that enabled top_k/min_p caused rollout-policy mismatch and degradation after 5-10 iterations, demonstrating runtime/version sensitivity.
RFT success-only selection discards failed attempts and can overrepresent already-solvable tasks.
The exact LLM-quality metadata field behind the score-3.0 filter is not named.
The 7,249-task and 2,028-task manifests are unavailable, so data selection cannot be audited record by record.
Repeated Verified-50 monitoring risks benchmark-guided model or hyperparameter selection.
Current SWE-rebench adds a post-paper 6,542-row filtered split; it must not be confused with the paper's 6,548 RFT trajectories.
Container tags and runtime dependencies are not bound to immutable digests in a paper-specific manifest.
Reported scores are author results; no independent reproduction or released checkpoint was verified.
